name: Hello World
author: ChuckBuilds
description: A simple test plugin that displays a customizable message

versions.notes: Saved settings now apply without a restart. The core applies a web-UI save by calling on_config_change, not by reloading the plugin, and the base version only replaces self.config; this plugin copied every setting into attributes in __init__, so a save changed nothing on the panel until a restart. Settings are read in _load_config(), called from __init__ and on_config_change, and the font registrations (which carry the colours) are redone. As the starter template, it now shows the pattern new plugins copy.
The clock now shows the configured LEDMatrix timezone instead of the Pi's system time, falling back to system time when the setting is missing or invalid.
Validation-sweep fixes; see the PR for the specific defect.
